By leveraging Medicare's GUIDE program, we provide these services to patients at no cost -- and produce new revenue for their doctors in the process.

about_short_description.short_description: Better care for dementia patients. New revenue for their doctors.

product.name: Craniometrix GUIDE Program
product.description: A dementia care program enabling providers to enroll patients in Medicare's GUIDE model, offering care navigation and support services.

product.name: Care Central Application
product.description: A software platform for providers and care navigators to collaborate and manage dementia care in compliance with GUIDE requirements.

product.name: Comprehensive Assessments
product.description: Digital assessments based on MIND at Home models to evaluate dementia patients' needs and inform care plans.

product.name: Personalized Care Plans
product.description: Template-based care plans generated from assessment data to guide dementia patient care and updated as needed.

product.name: 24/7 Caregiver Support Hotline
product.description: A live support line providing caregivers with access to dementia-trained specialists and assistance at any time.

identifier.value: Care Coordination and Transitional Care Management

product.name: Care Coordination and Transitional Care Management
product.description: Services that coordinate referrals to specialists and manage transitions in dementia patient care among providers and caregivers.
